title: Cloud Sync for a product role
summary: Diceroll's Cloud Sync page for a member whose role is on Diceroll only: platform controls (the default storage and the pause switch) are shown but disabled, each saying who can change them.
compare: Everything a product role may change works as on config.cloud-sync (tier values, the product's total storage).
Change… on the Default row is disabled and the row says "Only platform admins change it" with a lock.
The pause switch is disabled (aria-disabled), stays visible so the member knows it exists, and says "Only platform admins can pause writes. Ana Lima is one."
No control a member can't use looks active; nothing errors after a click.

Words: "player" for a game (Diceroll), "person" or "account" for an app (DJDL); storage in MiB and GiB, never MB; numbers and units never break across lines. products.integration's Cloud Sync card must say "Storage per person: 256 MiB by default (Standard uses the default)" to match this page.
